description: This file defines the interface 'LoanAmortizationAllocationService' which declares methods related to loan amortization allocation operations within a financial application, such as retrieving allocation data, calculating amortized amounts, and creating or setting amortization mappings.

classes.name: LoanAmortizationAllocationService
classes.description: Interface declaring services related to loan amortization allocations, including data retrieval, calculations, and creation of mappings.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAmortizationAllocationsForBuyDownFeeTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves amortization allocation data for a specific buy down fee transaction related to a loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanAmortizationAllocationsForCapitalizedIncomeTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves amortization allocation data for a specific capitalized income transaction related to a loan.

methods.name: calculateAlreadyAmortizedAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amount already amortized for a given loan transaction.

methods.name: createAmortizationAllocationMappingWithBaseLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new amortization allocation mapping using a base loan transaction, amount, and amortization type.

methods.name: setAmortizationTransactionDataAndSaveAmortizationAllocationMapping
methods.description: Sets amortization transaction data into an allocation mapping and persists it.
